body:
## Context
Issue #619: `untrackedNonIgnoredPaths` in `@adlc/core` runs `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`, which honours the repository `.gitignore`. Because `@adlc/core` is frozen, the issue recommends treating a `.gitignore` change within the reviewed change set as trust-root-tiering in `packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs` so widening the ignore set is itself subject to cross-model review.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `TRUST_ROOT_FILES` in `packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs` includes `'.gitignore'` so any diff modifying the root `.gitignore` is classified as trust-root tier (`trustRoot: true`, rule `'trust-root-file'`).
- Unit tests in `packages/prosecute/test/tier.test.mjs` verify that `.gitignore` triggers `trust-root-file` while nested `.gitignore` files do not match the exact root rule.

## Verification
`node --test packages/prosecute/test/tier.test.mjs packages/prosecute/test/cross-model.test.mjs packages/prosecute/test/untracked-file-refusal.test.mjs`
title: prosecute: classify .gitignore changes as trust-root tier (#619)
